issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: SKI
products.tagline: Free voice coding for Claude Code, Codex and more
products.summaryZh: Claude Code、Codex 等工具的免费语音编程
products.descriptionZh: 我们刚刚构建了SKI——为Claude Code、Codex等工具提供的语音编程方案。这不是听写：你的智能体会像真正的队友一样大声回应你，让你以思考的速度进行开发。你甚至可以把它带进会议现场实时构建，或者让它代替你发言。它是一款安静驻留在桌面上的工具——按下一个键，说话，即可工作。全部在你的设备上运行，免费。支持Mac和Windows。
products.description: We just built SKI — voice coding for Claude Code, Codex and more. It's not dictation: your agent answers you out loud, like a real teammate, so you build at the speed you think. You can even bring it into a meeting to build live, or send it in your place to speak for you. It's an ambient thing that just sits on your desktop — hit a key, talk, it works. All on your machine, free. Available on Mac & Windows.

products.name: Memmy Agent
products.tagline: Let every AI remember the same you.
products.summaryZh: 让每个AI记住同一个你。
products.descriptionZh: 🍙 Memmy Agent 是面向所有AI代理与工具（如Claude Code、Codex、OpenClaw和Hermes）的个人记忆中枢及本地AI代理。它为每个AI提供共享且完全受控的记忆——它们都记住同一个你。Memmy将对话、决策、偏好、进展和经历转化为长期记忆，将相关上下文带入匹配的任务中，也能直接承担工作。默认本地优先。你的记忆始终处于你的掌控之下：可随时管理。免费起步，附赠2M ChatGPT令牌。
products.description: 🍙 Memmy Agent is a personal memory hub and local AI agent for all AI Agent and tools like Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw and Hermes. Gives every AI one shared, full-controlled memory — they all remember the same you. Memmy turns chats, decisions, prefs, progresses, and experiences into long-term memory, brings the right context into matching task, also can take on work directly. Local-first by default. Your memory stay under your control: manage them anytime. Free start with 2M ChatGPT tokens.

products.name: AI Search Console
products.tagline: Prompt analytics and citation mapping for AI search
products.summaryZh: 面向AI搜索的提示分析与引文映射
products.descriptionZh: AI Search Console帮助SEO和GEO团队以可重复的数据取代手动AI可见性检查。追踪ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini和Perplexity中的品牌提及、排名、声量份额、竞争对手及引用来源。在单个提示词层面分析可见性，发现内容和引用缺口，无需电子表格或截图即可生成客户就绪报告。
products.description: AI Search Console helps SEO and GEO teams replace manual AI visibility checks with repeatable data. Track brand mentions, rankings, share of voice, competitors, and cited sources across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity. Analyze visibility at the individual prompt level, find content and citation gaps, and generate client-ready reports without spreadsheets or screenshots.

products.name: Claude Code usage tracking by LangWatch
products.tagline: See what your Claude Code sessions actually cost
products.summaryZh: 看看你的Claude Code会话实际花费了多少
products.descriptionZh: 跟踪Claude Code使用情况：成本、缓存、会话回放。运行一次`npx langwatch claude`。每个会话都会显示成本，其中缓存读取/写入作为独立的令牌类别，每次bash和MCP调用作为一个跨度，Max计划的理论成本与实际计费对比，以及UI中的完整终端回放。同样适用于Codex。
products.description: Track Claude Code usage: cost, cache, session replay. Run `npx langwatch claude` once. Every session gets cost with cache reads/writes as separate token classes, every bash and MCP call as a span, theoretical vs billed for your Max plan, and a full terminal replay in the UI. Works for Codex too.

products.name: NINA
products.tagline: Guide users step by step inside your product.
products.summaryZh: 在产品内逐步引导用户。
products.descriptionZh: NINA内置于你的产品中，在用户遇到困难时精准提供帮助。用户通过语音或文字询问“我该如何……？”，NINA会在实时界面上逐步引导他们，无需先提交工单、搜索文档或联系支持。它不是预设的演示流程、聊天机器人或常见问题解答。NINA专为仍依赖引导通话、产品视频、Slack频道和重复支持回复的B2B SaaS团队打造。
products.description: NINA lives inside your product and helps users exactly where they get stuck. They ask “How do I…?” by voice or text, and NINA guides them step by step on the live interface before they open a ticket, search documentation, or message support. It is not a scripted tour, chatbot, or FAQ. NINA is built for B2B SaaS teams still relying on onboarding calls, product videos, Slack channels, and repeated support answers.

products.name: Pally
products.tagline: Your personal assistant that lives in your texts
products.summaryZh: 你的私人助理，常驻于你的短信之中。
products.descriptionZh: Pally是你的个人助理，常驻于你的短信中。别再让消息石沉大海：让Pally替你回复，处理工作，节省时间。我们是唯一原生连接你iMessage和WhatsApp收件箱的文本代理，这意味着Pally能监控、提醒，甚至以你的语气、结合你的上下文，替你回复朋友。
products.description: Pally is your personal assistant that lives in your texts. Stop leaving people on read: let Pally reply for you, do your work, and save you time. We’re the only text agent that natively connects to your iMessage and WhatsApp inboxes, meaning Pally can monitor, alert, and even reply to your friends for you - in your tone, with your context.

products.name: Greplica
products.tagline: Self updating wiki for coding agents
products.summaryZh: 面向编码代理的自更新维基
products.descriptionZh: Greplica为你的工程团队和每个编码代理提供代码库的共享记忆。它持续从编码会话中提取决策、约束、陷阱、失败方法及文件级上下文，然后仅检索与当前任务相关的内容。与静态文档或孤立的代理记忆不同，Greplica始终扎根于仓库，保持知识新鲜，并跨开发者、代理、克隆和分支工作。它是开源的，本地运行，并提供托管共享模式。
products.description: Greplica gives your engineering team and every coding agent a shared memory of the codebase. It continuously extracts decisions, constraints, gotchas, failed approaches, and file-level context from coding sessions, then retrieves only what matters for the task at hand. Unlike static docs or siloed agent memory, Greplica stays grounded in the repo, keeps knowledge fresh, and works across developers, agents, clones, and forks. It is open source, runs locally, and offers a managed shared mode.

products.name: Expert Chase for iOS & Android
products.tagline: Where human life runs with AI
products.summaryZh: 在人类生活与AI同行之处
products.descriptionZh: 用户期待已久的功能现已上线。推出适用于iOS和Android的Expert Chase，同时带来强大的新体验和原生集成。Expert Chase现已在Web、iOS和Android平台可用，并支持Apple和Google生态系统。集成功能包括：Apple日历、Google日历、Apple提醒事项、Google任务、Apple健康、Google健康连接。
products.description: Our users wanted it, now they've got it. Introducing Expert Chase for iOS & Android, along with a powerful new experience and native integrations. Expert Chase is now available on Web, iOS, and Android, with support for both the Apple and Google ecosystems. Integrations include: Apple Calendar, Google Calendar, Apple Reminders, Google Tasks, Apple Health, Google Health Connect.

products.name: Focus Room
products.tagline: Turn YouTube into your personal learning platform
products.summaryZh: 把YouTube变成你的个人学习平台
products.descriptionZh: Focus Room将YouTube转变为一个个人学习平台，采用结构化的课程式界面。将教育视频和播放列表整理为有序课程，通过带时间戳的主题导航课程，生成简明摘要，创建笔记和待办清单，跟踪学习进度，并收藏课程供日后使用。去除无关推荐和干扰后，Focus Room帮助将被动观看转化为专注、持续的学习。
products.description: Focus Room turns YouTube into a personal learning platform with a structured, course-inspired interface. Convert educational videos and playlists into organized courses, navigate lessons using timestamped topics, generate concise summaries, create notes and to-do lists, track your progress, and bookmark courses for later. With unnecessary recommendations and distractions removed, Focus Room helps transform passive watching into focused, consistent learning.

products.name: agentOS
products.tagline: 254× cheaper sandbox alternative, powered by WebAssembly
products.summaryZh: 基于WebAssembly的沙箱替代方案，成本降低254倍
products.descriptionZh: 为智能体提供Linux操作系统作为库——无需沙箱、虚拟机或SaaS。基于WebAssembly构建，与Cloudflare Workers和Chrome采用相同技术。支持Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Pi、Eve和Flue。
products.description: Give agents a Linux operating system as a library – no sandboxes, VMs, or SaaS. Built on WebAssembly, the same tech powering Cloudflare Workers and Chrome. Support Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Eve, and Flue.

products.name: Yap
products.tagline: Open-source voice dictation for Mac, fully on-device
products.summaryZh: Mac 上的开源语音听写，完全离线运行
products.descriptionZh: Yap 能在 Mac 上任何可输入文字的地方将语音转为文本。设置一个快捷键，说话，再按一次，文字便会粘贴到当前所在的输入框。它完全在设备上运行，利用 macOS 26 的语音 API，因此无需下载模型，也不会有任何数据离开你的设备。应用约 3,000 行原生 Swift 代码，体积 4 MB，空闲时内存占用接近 60 MB。免费，采用 MIT 许可证，由 Frigade 开发，因为我们自己也需要这样的工具。
products.description: Yap turns speech into text anywhere you can type on your Mac. Set a hotkey, talk, press it again, and the words get pasted into whatever field you were in. It runs entirely on device using macOS 26's speech APIs, so there's no model to download and nothing leaves your machine. It's around 3,000 lines of native Swift in a 4 MB app that idles near 60 MB of memory. Free, MIT licensed, and built by Frigade because we wanted it for ourselves.

products.name: CraftStory
products.tagline: Photorealistic human video, powered by compact AI
products.summaryZh: 紧凑AI驱动的照片级真实人物视频
products.descriptionZh: 🎁 Product Hunt 独家优惠：Producer 首月五折 → https://app.craftstory.com/?promo=producthunt CraftStory 为学习与发展、播客和 UGC 生成超逼真、以人为中心的视频。仅凭一张图片即可创建视频，或通过一段 15 秒的视频训练自定义虚拟形象。CraftStory 基于专有模型，该模型使用通过收益分成协议授权的专业演员素材训练，以每秒 4.5 美分的成本提供逼真、富有表现力的视频。
products.description: 🎁 Product Hunt exclusive: 50% off Producer for your first month → https://app.craftstory.com/?promo=producthunt CraftStory generates hyper-realistic, human-centric videos for L&D, podcasts, and UGC. Create videos from a single image or train a custom avatar from just a 15-second video. Powered by a proprietary model trained on professional actor footage licensed through revenue-sharing agreements, CraftStory delivers realistic, expressive videos at just 4.5 cents per second.

products.name: tablo
products.tagline: A tiny cat that watches your AI coding agents for you
products.summaryZh: 一只为你盯着AI编程助手的小猫
products.descriptionZh: 你启动一个AI代理，切换标签页，然后忘记它卡住了或上下文窗口已用掉90%。tablo解决了这个问题，一只小猫蹲在屏幕角落，盯着每一次Claude Code和Codex会话：实时上下文计量、工具审批，以及一旦需要你时立刻的提醒。与使用量仪表板不同，tablo实时追踪每个会话的对话上下文填充情况，覆盖两种工具——以一个不碍事的小组件呈现。默认就很舒适。🐱
products.description: You kick off an AI agent, switch tabs, and forget it's stuck or 90% through its context window. tablo fixes that, a tiny cat in your screen corner watching every Claude Code & Codex session: live context meters, tool approvals, and a nudge the second one needs you. Unlike usage dashboards, tablo tracks the conversation context filling up in real time, per session, across both tools — in a widget that stays out of your way. cozy by default. 🐱

products.name: Caimera
products.tagline: AI Visual Production Platform for Fashion Teams
products.summaryZh: 面向时尚团队的AI视觉制作平台
products.descriptionZh: 从草图到销售——Caimera助力电商品牌更快上市。利用AI创作惊艳的产品图片、视频和社交媒体内容。
products.description: From sketch to sale — Caimera helps e-commerce brands go to market faster. Create stunning product photos, videos, and social content with AI.

products.name: Premation
products.tagline: An open-source AI alternative to After Effects
products.summaryZh: After Effects的开源AI替代品
products.descriptionZh: Motion Editor是一款开源的、AI原生的Adobe After Effects替代品。与闭源动态工具不同，它为创作者和开发者提供了定制、扩展及在此平台上构建的自由度。它结合了基于时间轴的编辑、2D/3D动态设计以及集成的AI辅助，打造出现代、社区驱动的动态图形体验。
products.description: Motion Editor is an open-source, AI-native alternative to Adobe After Effects. Unlike closed-source motion tools, it gives creators and developers the freedom to customize, extend, and build on the platform. It combines timeline-based editing, 2D/3D motion design, and integrated AI assistance to create a modern, community-driven motion graphics experience.

products.name: Laxis
products.tagline: Make meeting notes awesome, type 4x faster, translate live
products.summaryZh: 让会议记录更出色，打字速度提升4倍，实时翻译
products.descriptionZh: 记笔记的人无法听写。听写应用无法主持你的会议。Laxis两者兼备——无需机器人即可录制并总结会议，然后以比打字更快的速度听写邮件和笔记。支持100多种语言的实时转录和翻译。受到超过10万名专业人士的信赖。
products.description: Note-takers can't dictate. Dictation apps can't run your meetings. Laxis does both — record and summarize meetings bot-free, then dictate emails and notes faster than you type. Live transcription and translation in 100+ languages. Trusted by 100,000+ professionals.

products.name: docktor
products.tagline: Your Dock's wasted side space, now full of widgets
products.summaryZh: 你的程序坞浪费的侧边空间，现在可以放满小组件了。
products.descriptionZh: 如果你不隐藏Dock，它的两侧通常会有浪费的空间。Docktor用你真正会瞄一眼的小组件填满这些空间：音乐、日历、天气、系统状态等，更多功能即将推出。没有额外的菜单栏图标抢占位置，也没有需要单独打开的窗口。只是你经常查看的内容，停放在Mac本已浪费的空间里。它还为你Dock添加了悬停预览——鼠标悬停在一个应用上，无需点击即可看到其打开的窗口。
products.description: If you don't hide your Dock, you've probably got wasted space sitting on either side of it. Docktor fills it with widgets you actually glance at: music, calendar, weather, system stats and more coming soon. No extra menu-bar icon fighting for room. No separate window to open. Just the stuff you check constantly, parked in space your Mac was already wasting. It also adds hover previews to your Dock — mouse over an app and see its open windows without clicking.

products.name: Cursor Crane
products.tagline: Control your Mac at the pace of your keyboard
products.summaryZh: 以键盘的节奏掌控你的Mac
products.descriptionZh: 大多数基于提示的Mac工具专注于UI元素。Cursor Crane将相同的交互模式扩展到窗口、多窗口工作流和文本编辑。其专用模式使用可预测而非随意的提示。输入命令序列以切换模式、执行操作或运行脚本。它还使仅用键盘操作的笨拙任务变得实用：跨行选择文本、通过Text Area Portal在外部编辑器中编辑聚焦字段，以及通过Element Menu复制文本或捕获UI。
products.description: Most hint-based Mac tools focus on UI elements. Cursor Crane extends the same interaction model to windows, multi-window workflows, and text editing. Its dedicated modes use predictable rather than arbitrary hints. Enter command sequences to switch modes, perform actions, or run scripts. It also makes awkward keyboard-only tasks practical: selecting text across lines, editing focused fields in an external editor with Text Area Portal, and copying text or capturing UI through Element Menu.

products.name: Virre
products.tagline: A private relationship system for your career and network.
products.summaryZh: 一个专为职业与社交网络打造的私密关系系统。
products.descriptionZh: Virre 是一款私人关系情报系统，帮助你将现有的人脉转化为有意义的机会。它将你的社交网络、对话、目标、活动和后续跟进整合于一处，并推荐哪些人重要、为何重要以及下一步该做什么——而不会将关系变成交易。
products.description: Virre is a private relationship intelligence system that helps you turn existing connections into meaningful opportunities. It brings your network, conversations, goals, events, and follow-ups into one place, then recommends who matters, why they matter, and what to do next—without turning relationships into transactions.

products.name: Sorinai
products.tagline: The Interative AI Notepad for Meetings
products.summaryZh: 交互式AI会议记事本
products.descriptionZh: Sorinai是一款交互式AI记事本，能随你一起完善会议笔记。放入你已使用的模板，无论是Word、PDF还是纯文本，它都能读取结构，并根据通话内容填充每个字段。无需机器人加入会议；它通过捕捉电脑音频工作，因此视频通话、电话会议和面对面交流均适用。通话中可随时询问下一步该说什么，之后可查询单次会议或全部会议。支持Mac和Windows系统。笔记无限量，免费使用。
products.description: Sorinai is an interactive AI notepad that fills out your meeting notes along with you. Drop in the template you already use, Word, PDF or plain text, and it reads the structure and fills every field from the call. No bot joins your meeting; it captures your computer's audio, so video calls, phone calls and in-person all work. Ask it what to say next while you're still on the call, then query one meeting or all of them at once. Mac and Windows. Unlimited notes, free.
